content.introduction: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq fluctuated, with mixed performances in European and Asian markets influenced by geopolitical events. Gold and copper prices rose, while major indices like the S&P 500, FTSE 100, and Nikkei 225 showed positive trends. Tech stocks had a strong six-month performance despite some setbacks.
body: S&P 500 and Nasdaq close lower as chip stock rebound fails. Sean ConlonTue, Jun 9th 2026. S&P 500 closes higher as chips stage a comeback, Iran stops strikes on Israel. Asia-Pacific markets trade higher as investors assess U.S.-Iran peace deal diplomacy. Asia markets trade mixed as oil eases after Trump delays planned Iran strike. European markets rebound after Trump threatens Iran. European stocks close lower, sterling slides on UK political turmoil. European markets end higher as Iran's peace talks stall, defense stocks slide. European stocks close higher as Iran war concerns weigh on sentiment. European stocks close lower as Trump considers Iran peace proposal, UAE leaves OPEC. European markets close lower as Iran reportedly makes peace proposal. European stocks lower as U.S.-Iran ceasefire deadline looms. European stocks end near flat as UK GDP jumps and Iran peace talks remain in focus. European markets close lower as Iran peace hopes fade. Asia markets trade lower as oil surges after U.S. moves to blockade Iran ports.
